name: Vinecaller (Floral)
body:
Your bond affects your magic, granting you additional spontaneous casting options.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Flora, ability to spontaneously cast spells.

Benefit(s): Like roots digging into soil, your plant magic has begun to creep into your spontaneous magic. You can “lose” any prepared spell of equal or higher level in order to cast entangle, sickening entanglement, or thorny entanglement.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
